triples.rationale: The Lord first commands the sea creature to swallow Jonah. Later the creature is commanded, and it casts him onto dry land; the later command's content is unstated. The two reported commands frame his confinement and release.
triples.source_text: The sea creature was commanded, and it cast Jonah out onto dry land.

target_units.text: The Lord commanded a great sea creature to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the sea creature’s belly three days and three nights.
